subject: Technical Lead portfolio rebalance & proposed reporting changes
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical Lead portfolio rebalance & proposed reporting changes

Hi all,

I wanted to circulate a concise proposal for rebalancing the senior technical lead portfolios across Platform & Runtime. The goal is to increase specialization (runtime/compilation vs API/platform features) while keeping manager spans within the recommended 6-8 ICs. High level:

- Split the current "Platform Services" pod into two focused teams: Runtime & Serving (GPU/quantization/ops) and API & Features (SDKs, CLI, surface APIs).
- Move three tech leads (names below) to Runtime & Serving; two leads stay on API & Features.
- Change direct reporting for Runtime to Marcus (as acting runtime lead) and keep product-facing leads with Marissa. Naomi will remain scoped for career ladders and calibration.

Initial people list (proposed moves):
- Priya Natarajan -> Runtime & Serving (reporting to Marcus)
- Vivek Kulkarni -> Runtime & Serving (reporting to Marcus)
- Diego Fernandez -> Runtime & Serving (reporting to Marcus)
- Mina Haddad -> API & Features (reporting to Marissa)
- Logan Wright -> API & Features (reporting to Marissa)

What I need from you this week:
1) Quick take on risks (headcount, promotions, span of control).
2) Any lead or IC you believe should be treated as a sensitive case (potential performance or career-impact conversation).
3) If you agree, I propose a phased approach: move ownership and day-to-day reporting now, delay title/promotions until after the Oct performance cycle + calibration.

Attachments: reorg_rationale.pdf (1-page), role_matrix.xlsx (mapping of responsibilities).

Notes on timing: I know this overlaps with the upcoming performance review window. If we can't sign off now, my fallback is a matrix reporting model until we finalize titles post-review.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical Lead portfolio rebalance & proposed reporting changes

Thanks for the clear write-up, Karthik — I like the specialization direction. A few quick questions:

- Headcount/promo budget: do we have budget capacity to convert any of these lateral moves into promotion bands after the reorg? I need to understand if we plan to promote in-line with reassignment or keep titles steady as you suggested.
- Risk list: Logan's current ownership of the SDK roadmap is critical for Q4 deliverables; we should avoid any handoff that risks slipping the SDK milestones.
- Sensitive cases: Diego had a flagged performance conversation earlier this year (documented in his 1:1 notes). If we move him, we should coordinate tightly with People Ops on communication and potential PIP history.

Can we loop People Ops and an external change consultant for the comms plan and to validate wording for manager 1:1s? I'm copying a request to People Ops here (will add them explicitly once Karthik confirms).

-marissa

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical Lead portfolio rebalance & proposed reporting changes

Appreciate the draft, Karthik. Two concerns from my side:

1) Timing with performance reviews: We have calibration scheduled for the week of Oct 12 and manager ratings due Oct 5. If we change reporting relationships before managers do their calibration work, we risk inconsistent rating context and make the appeals/normalization harder.

2) Career ladder clarity: For a couple of the leads (Priya in particular), a lateral move without title change could be perceived as a demotion unless we communicate the rationale carefully. I recommend we standardize a short script for 1:1s that highlights scope increase or focus shift, and defers compensation/title changes to post-calibration.

Proposal:
- Implement ownership transfers (who does what day-to-day) effective Sep 22 with matrix reporting for review/feedback until Oct 31.
- No title or comp changes communicated until after calibration on Oct 12, with any promotions effective Nov 1.
- Schedule 1:1s with the five affected leads the week of Sep 20 — managers only, with People Ops on standby for sensitive conversations.

I've attached a first-pass role_matrix.xlsx with suggested wording for the scripts and an alignment table for calibration. Also, request we bring in external change counsel (Elena Morris) to sanity-check the comms for higher-risk cases.

-naomi

Cc: Elena Morris <elena@orgchange.co>, People Ops <peopleops@acmehr.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical Lead portfolio rebalance & proposed reporting changes

Thanks — great feedback and agreed on cautious pacing. Final proposal below (short and actionable):

1) Phase 1 (Sep 22) — Ownership handoffs only
   - Day-to-day task ownership and meeting cadences move to new leads.
   - No title or comp changes communicated.
   - Matrix reporting window until Oct 31 to surface any issues during the review period.

2) Phase 2 (post-calibration) — Titles & promotions (Nov 1 effective)
   - After Oct calibration, teams will review nominations for promotion (if any) and we will coordinate comp approvals.

3) Communication plan
   - Managers conduct 1:1s week of Sep 20 to explain ownership changes; People Ops (cc'd) will stand-by for sensitive cases.
   - Draft all-team announcement for Oct 25.

4) Sensitive cases:
   - Diego Fernandez flagged as potential sensitive case — Elena, can you review the included case notes and advise on manager script?

Attachments: reorg_rationale.pdf, role_matrix.xlsx
Drive draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-reorg-draft

If that timelines works, I'll book the manager-only sync for Sep 17 to walk through scripts and checklists. Please call out any absolute blockers by EOD Monday (Sep 13).

Thanks,
Karthik
